Fonts bundled with the DSA Visualizer
=====================================

Both typefaces are served from this site rather than from a font CDN, so the
app makes no third-party request. Under the SIL Open Font License the copyright
notice and licence have to travel with the font files, which is what the two
LICENSE-*.txt files beside this one are.

The .woff2 files are the `latin` subset builds that Google Fonts serves,
downloaded unmodified. Each is a variable font: one file covers the whole
weight axis, which is why there is one file per family rather than one per
weight.


JetBrains Mono
--------------
  File       jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2
  Licence    SIL Open Font License 1.1  -  LICENSE-JetBrainsMono.txt
  Copyright  Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
             (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
  Upstream   https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono


IBM Plex Sans
-------------
  File       ibm-plex-sans-latin.woff2
  Licence    SIL Open Font License 1.1  -  LICENSE-IBMPlexSans.txt
  Copyright  Copyright (c) 2017 IBM Corp. with Reserved Font Name "Plex"
  Upstream   https://github.com/IBM/plex


The OFL permits redistribution, embedding and use on a website at no cost. It
asks three things of anyone passing the fonts on: keep the copyright notice and
licence with them (done here), don't sell the fonts on their own, and don't use
a Reserved Font Name for a modified version. "Plex" is a Reserved Font Name.
